title: Penny the Little Lamb and the Sleepy Harvest Lights
description: A little ivory lamb and her piglet friend tidy a tiny harvest festival by the red barn, watch the sleepy lanterns glow, and settle into cozy straw nests for the night.

Penny.color: Warm-ivory wool with a creamy peach face, cocoa-brown nose, dark-chocolate eyes, and one cinnamon-brown oval patch on her left ear
Penny.bodyShape: Small round-bodied baby lamb with soft curled wool, four short legs, and a short fluffy tail; no horns, shoes, hands, or clothing beyond her ribbon
Penny.face: Large dark-chocolate eyes with a soft catchlight when open and a gentle curved smile
Penny.accessories: Narrow muted-coral ribbon tied in a simple bow at the base of her neck

Gus.role: Supporting character; a tiny piglet who first appears on page 4
Gus.color: Warm-peach skin with darker rosy hooves, dusty-rose ear interiors, and one caramel-brown spot on his right cheek
Gus.bodyShape: Small plump piglet shorter than Penny, with a rounded head and belly, short sturdy legs, little triangular ears, a broad oval snout with two nostrils, and a small curled tail; no hands, shoes, or clothing beyond his neckerchief
Gus.face: Dark-brown round eyes with a single catchlight when open and a happy little snout
Gus.accessories: Simple dusty-teal neckerchief tied behind his neck without long dangling ends

settingBible.Harvest Farm Barn: One peaceful family farm with a large weathered red barn, white trim, a pitched roof, and a harvest-festival corner with three orange pumpkins, two golden hay bales, a red-and-cream gingham blanket, a low wooden crate, a small wicker apple basket, and five warm amber paper lanterns
settingBible.Sleeping Corner: Inside the same red barn: a cozy straw area with a small square window on the left rear wall, Penny's larger cream-tinted nest on the left, and Gus's slightly smaller golden nest on the right
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded farm animals, golden afternoon fading to moonlit blue, one scene per page, and no readable text on story pages

continuityRules: Penny keeps warm-ivory wool, a cinnamon left-ear patch, and a muted-coral neck ribbon.
Gus stays smaller than Penny with a right-cheek caramel spot and a dusty-teal neckerchief, and first appears on page 4.
Pages 12–15 keep Penny in the left nest and Gus in the right nest inside the same barn.
Exactly five lanterns, three pumpkins, and two hay bales stay with the outdoor festival; the gingham blanket remains outside.
No rescue, danger, fire, or extra named characters.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words on story-page artwork.

pages.text: As the evening sun warmed the farm, Penny the little lamb peeked at the tiny harvest festival beside the red barn.
pages.illustrationScene: Little ivory lamb Penny peeks at the tiny harvest festival beside the red barn in warm evening sun.

pages.text: She admired the round pumpkins, neat hay bales, and paper lanterns waiting beneath the barn's wide roof.
pages.illustrationScene: Penny admires round pumpkins, neat hay bales, and paper lanterns waiting under the barn roof.

pages.text: Penny gently straightened a crooked gingham blanket, making a cozy place where friends could sit.
pages.illustrationScene: Penny gently straightens a crooked gingham blanket into a cozy sitting place.

pages.text: Her friend Gus the piglet trotted over with a small basket of shiny red apples.
pages.illustrationScene: Piglet Gus trots over with a small wicker basket of shiny red apples as Penny greets him.
pages.continuityNotes: Penny and Gus; ear patch LEFT, Gus cheek spot RIGHT.

pages.text: Together, they set the apples beside the pumpkins and stepped back to admire their cheerful little festival.
pages.illustrationScene: Penny and Gus set the apples beside the pumpkins and admire their cheerful little festival.
pages.continuityNotes: Penny and Gus; ear patch LEFT, Gus cheek spot RIGHT.

pages.text: When the first lanterns glowed, Penny and Gus shared an apple slice on the soft gingham blanket.
pages.illustrationScene: Penny and Gus share an apple slice on the soft gingham blanket as the first lanterns glow.
pages.continuityNotes: Penny and Gus; ear patch LEFT, Gus cheek spot RIGHT.

pages.text: A light evening breeze swayed the lanterns, and the two friends watched their warm colors dance across the hay.
pages.illustrationScene: Penny and Gus watch warm lantern colors dance across the hay in a light evening breeze.
pages.continuityNotes: Penny and Gus; ear patch LEFT, Gus cheek spot RIGHT.

pages.text: Gus gave a happy little wiggle, but Penny showed him the biggest pumpkin, round as a sleepy moon.
pages.illustrationScene: Penny shows Gus the biggest pumpkin beside the hay bales in early twilight.
pages.continuityNotes: Penny and Gus; ear patch LEFT, Gus cheek spot RIGHT.

pages.text: Above the barn, the sky turned lavender, and the last visitors wandered home along the garden path.
pages.illustrationScene: Penny and Gus watch the last distant visitors wander home along the garden path at lavender dusk.
pages.continuityNotes: Penny and Gus; ear patch LEFT, Gus cheek spot RIGHT.

pages.text: Penny and Gus carried the little apple basket inside while the lanterns shone softly by the barn door.
pages.illustrationScene: Penny and Gus carry the little apple basket through the barn doorway as lanterns shine softly outside.
pages.continuityNotes: Penny and Gus; ear patch LEFT, Gus cheek spot RIGHT.

pages.text: Gus yawned a wide piglet yawn, and Penny smiled because her own eyes were growing heavy.
pages.illustrationScene: Gus yawns a wide piglet yawn at the barn threshold while Penny's eyes grow heavy.
pages.continuityNotes: Penny and Gus; ear patch LEFT, Gus cheek spot RIGHT.

pages.text: Side by side, they padded into the barn's snug sleeping corner, where fresh straw waited beneath a small window.
pages.illustrationScene: Penny and Gus pad into the barn's snug sleeping corner where fresh straw waits beneath a small window.
pages.continuityNotes: Penny and Gus; ear patch LEFT, Gus cheek spot RIGHT. Nest layout fixed: Penny LEFT, Gus RIGHT.

pages.text: Penny curled into her cream-colored straw nest, and Gus nestled into his smaller straw nest right beside her.
pages.illustrationScene: Penny curls into her larger cream straw nest on the left while Gus nestles into his smaller nest on the right.
pages.continuityNotes: Penny and Gus; ear patch LEFT, Gus cheek spot RIGHT. Nest layout fixed: Penny LEFT, Gus RIGHT.

pages.text: Moonlight slipped through the window as the friends tucked in close together and closed their eyes.
pages.illustrationScene: Moonlight slips through the left window as Penny and Gus tuck in close with eyes fully closed.
pages.continuityNotes: Penny and Gus; ear patch LEFT, Gus cheek spot RIGHT. Nest layout fixed: Penny LEFT, Gus RIGHT. Both eyes fully closed.

pages.text: With the festival lights twinkling faintly outside, Penny and Gus drifted peacefully to sleep in their warm, quiet barn.
pages.illustrationScene: Penny and Gus sleep peacefully in their warm quiet barn while festival lights twinkle faintly outside.
pages.continuityNotes: Penny and Gus; ear patch LEFT, Gus cheek spot RIGHT. Nest layout fixed: Penny LEFT, Gus RIGHT. Both eyes fully closed.
